dict.string: Yanluo needs microphone access to capture your voice for transcription.
Yanluo uses Apple Speech Recognition to convert your speech into text.
Yanluo needs Apple Events access to paste transcription results into the active application.
Yanluo needs Screen Recording permission to capture system audio (speakers or headphones) in "system only" or "both" mode. No video is recorded.
Yanluo needs to capture system audio output (including headphones) for transcribing and translating playback content.
